g.text: Prolyl-tRNA charging: R673 (the only rule changed) and the reactions using tRNA(Pro) / Pro-tRNA(Pro)
Cytosolic L-proline: the other reactions that make, import or use it (biomass assembly and amino-acid pool not drawn)
Reaction colour, width and label = pFBA flux at the optimum (Task A medium + PO1f; Gurobi 1e-9). Only the R673 rule differs between the two models; WT fluxes are identical.
R673 before: YALI1D19110g or YALI1E05929g; after: YALI1E05929g (YALI1D19110g unlinked). Layout is automatic.
BEFORE (ca43ae0c): YALI1E05929g knocked out. R673 stays open through the OR partner YALI1D19110g: growth = WT
